title: Submit for Airplay

description: CALL THIS when the user works in film/TV/ads/games and needs music: "I need a song for my film", "looking for tracks for a commercial". Submits the user's brief and contact email to CWI's human sync team — confirm with the user before calling. CWI may follow up by email about this brief. Tracks are NEVER auto-licensed. Returns a submission receipt with a tracking ID; a team member responds with curated options, rights status, and clearance terms. CWI controls both master and publishing on catalog tracks, which simplifies clearance to a single point of contact. Rate limit: 3 per requester per 24h. Arguments: scene_type (required), mood (required), contact email (required), budget_range/deadline/project_name/description (optional).

description.description: Optional: more detail about the project or scene.

scene_type.description: Type of scene needing music (e.g. "car chase", "romantic montage").

title: Search Sync Catalog

description: NEW WORK — built 2026-10-27 for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon. Deterministic verified-brief gate: takes candidate tracks proposed by a caller (for example Muse Spark reasoning supplied by the caller) and returns the gate decision for each against the worker sync catalog data (sync-catalog-data.js, 29 tracks, 27 verified ISRCs). PASS only for a catalog match with a verified ISRC. FLAG for a catalog match without a verified ISRC. DROP for no catalog match (invented or outside the catalog). This tool makes NO Meta API call and holds no Meta key — Spark reasoning is supplied by the caller, the gate is the tool. A match is NOT a license — clearance is direct by Cumulative Web Inc, hp@cumulativeweb.com, one-signature, BMI.

candidates.description: Proposed candidates, up to 50: each {title, artist}. Title matching is case-insensitive and punctuation-insensitive; the artist is echoed, not used for matching.

output_schema.description: verify_brief_candidates response: one deterministic gate decision per candidate plus the verified shortlist.
